# Crush

> A paid social chat platform where verified creators run Friends Lists and members subscribe to chat, meet, and make real connections.

Crush pairs members with verified creators through private Friends Lists, DMs, group Rooms near you, coin gifting, and an AI copilot that helps members craft better conversations. Payments are handled by Stripe; creators are compensated partners.

## Pages
- [Home](/): overview of Crush, online creators, and featured Friends Lists
- [Discover creators](/discover): browse and search verified creators by tier
- [Rooms near you](/rooms): live group chat rooms in cities across the US
- [Crush AI copilot](/copilot): AI wingman that helps members write better messages
- [Upgrade](/upgrade): Crush Gold and Crush Diamond VIP membership plans
- [Buy coins](/coins): coin packs used for gifting and tipping creators
- [Sign in / Join free](/auth): create an account or sign in
